title: Mission priority file
description: Swappable input that sets what matters on this mission. The jury may hand us an unseen one, so the governor validates it before use and refuses a bad file with the field that is wrong.

weights.description: Weight 0 to 1 for every capability name a guest card can return.

shed_order.description: Optional (freeze F3): guests shed in this declared order before the computed one; names must be known guests.
